readme: THI-814 golden set (spec-p1-1 rev 7766d9c3 §8 'Golden set'): 50 items shaped
{id, text?, photo?, expected:{category, attributes, condition}}. Both inputs
are optional per spec; 46 text-only + 4 with a tiny committed photo so the
photo path stays in the harness. Categories/attributes follow the seeded
registry in db/schema.sql (keys declared for the expected category, enum
values in declared casing). 'id' is harness plumbing: it keys
Acceptance (measured live by scripts/extraction-eval.ts, posted as PR
responses offline — it tests the pipeline, not the model.
